newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: PRAGUE BOURSE TO START PUBLISHING AVG BOND RATES.
newsitem.headline: PRAGUE BOURSE TO START PUBLISHING AVG BOND RATES.

text.p: The Prague Stock Exchange (PSE) said on Thursday that from next Monday it would begin to publish average reference prices for bonds.

"From that date the bourse will provide from so-called market makers price listings of selected bond issues and will list daily average reference prices of bids and offers," PSE spokesman Milan Vodicka said in a statement.
Market makers will provide prices by 10.00 a.m. (0800 gmt) each trading day and they will be published at 11.00 a.m. through the bourse's electronic systems.
The move seeks to concentrate more of the bond trading among market makers on the PSE.

The bonds will be divided into three groups. Group A will be state bonds, Group B will be corporate issues with a minimum issued volume of two billion crowns, and Group C will be the remaining issues.
